ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'And your garments, purify' in Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this command to purify garments is often viewed as a precursor to the verse of purification (Ayat al-Tathir), linking physical cleanliness to the spiritual purity of the Ahl al-Bayt. Scholars emphasize that just as the Prophet was instructed to cleanse his outer attire, he and his progeny are divinely protected from impurity, serving as a model for believers to integrate external ritual purity with internal moral refinement.
